text: Aside from language, Austronesian peoples widely share cultural characteristics, including such traditions and traditional technologies as lashed-lug shipbuilding, tattooing, stilt houses, jade carving, wetland agriculture, and various rock art motifs.

title: Wae Rana language — Grokipedia
text: Wae Rana is an Austronesian language belonging to the Malayo-Polynesian branch, specifically within the Central Malayo-Polynesian subgroup. It is classified under the broader Sumba–Flores subgroup, which encompasses languages spoken on Flores and adjacent islands.
